lessons.title: おもいなおす (omoinaosu) — to think again; to change one's mind
lessons.gloss: to think again; to change one's mind

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Japanese for to slip up, then the Japanese for a fault.

blocks.title: You'll want to know: おもいなおす

segments.text: おもいなおす — omoinaosu — "to think again; to change one's mind".
もし いま やめたら、かれは あとで おもいなおすでしょう。 — moshi ima yametara, kare wa ato de omoinaosu deshō — "If he quits now, he will probably think again later."
Polite おもいなおします, omoinaoshimasu; a godan verb. Past (polite): ちちが ひっこしを おもいなおしました。, chichi ga hikkoshi o omoinaoshimashita.

おもいなおす (omoinaosu) is a native Japanese word (wago), inherited rather than borrowed from Chinese, built from omou, "to think", and naosu, "to fix"; its kanji was attached later as a kun'yomi (JMdict, KANJIDIC2).
One more word for saying what happens if.

lessons.title: おもいとどまる (omoitodomaru) — to think better of (doing)

blocks.title: You'll want to know: おもいとどまる

segments.text: おもいとどまる — omoitodomaru — "to think better of (doing)".
もし ははの いけんを きいたら、かれも おもいとどまるでしょう。 — moshi haha no iken o kiitara, kare mo omoitodomaru deshō — "If he listens to his mother's opinion, he too will probably think better of it."

おもいとどまる (omoitodomaru) is a native Japanese word (wago), inherited rather than borrowed from Chinese, built from omou, "to think", and todomaru, "to stay"; its kanji was attached later as a kun'yomi (JMdict, KANJIDIC2).

blocks.title: You'll want to know: みかぎる

segments.text: みかぎる — mikagiru — "to give up on (someone)".
もし かれが いつも おくれたら、みんな かれを みかぎるでしょう。 — moshi kare ga itsumo okuretara, minna kare o mikagiru deshō — "If he is always late, everyone will give up on him."
Polite みかぎります, mikagirimasu; a godan verb. Past (polite): きゃくが みせを みかぎりました。, kyaku ga mise o mikagirimashita.
みかぎる (mikagiru) is a native Japanese word (wago), inherited rather than borrowed from Chinese; its kanji was attached later as a kun'yomi, and its older origin is not settled (JMdict, KANJIDIC2).

もし かれが ともだちを うらぎったら、ともだちは おこるでしょう。 — moshi kare ga tomodachi o uragittara, tomodachi wa okoru deshō — "If he betrays his friends, they will be angry."

lessons.title: ぶなん (bunan) — safe (as a choice); acceptable

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Japanese for to give up on (someone), then the Japanese for to betray.

blocks.title: You'll want to know: ぶなん

segments.text: ぶなん — bunan — "safe (as a choice); acceptable".
もし まよったら、この みちが ぶなんです。 — moshi mayottara, kono michi ga bunan desu — "If you are unsure, this road is the safe choice."
A na-adjective: な before a noun.

ぶなん (bunan) is Sino-Japanese (kango): two Chinese characters read with their on'yomi, readings borrowed from Chinese. They are bu, "nothingness" (Middle Chinese mju) and nan, "difficult" (nan) (KANJIDIC2; Middle Chinese in Baxter's transcription).
One more word for saying what happens if.
